goal: Complete and publish the four production repairs before starting Professor.

The page still hides valid results

requirements.statement: A last-minute business entry checks all units in the property for the selected dates and guests, while checkout uses only a verified exact room.
The business calendar visibly exposes supplier minimum-night rules and a truthful verified price basis for its initial date window.
The permanent last-minute page visibly renders every verified deal returned by its authoritative data source without a slider cap.
Geography administration shows and filters every town missing a complete map point and reconciles the count.
requirements.source: User correction and current admin semantics

requirements.statement: All four defects have deterministic QQQAAA coverage and the complete candidate is published and verified live.
requirements.source: User publication authorization and VII release standard

acceptance_checks.setup: Open the supplied Raphael Bekerem URL with an incoming roomID.
acceptance_checks.action: Load the business and inspect all unit cards for the selected stay.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every supplier room is evaluated; the incoming room is context only and another available room is not hidden.

acceptance_checks.action: Inspect available arrival days and select a range.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The day exposes units, minimum nights and a supplier-verified minimum-stay total when available; range validation respects the same rule.

acceptance_checks.setup: Supplier price enrichment fails while the calendar itself succeeds.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Availability and minimum nights remain usable and no price is invented.

acceptance_checks.setup: The home-deals API returns N verified tomorrow deals.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Exactly N distinct deal cards are reachable in a normal grid with no slice or hidden horizontal rail.

acceptance_checks.setup: The geography store contains towns with a missing latitude or longitude.
acceptance_checks.action: Activate the missing-points control and open a row.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The filtered count equals the rows, each town is named, and the existing coordinate editor opens.

acceptance_checks.setup: An authorized administrator saves valid coordinates.
acceptance_checks.action: Reload and reactivate the missing-points filter.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The saved town leaves the missing list and the metrics reconcile; unauthorized access stays denied.

acceptance_checks.action: Run focused, full and QQQAAA checks, publish once and inspect the live release.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The exact public version passes the affected flows and the previous public version remains a recorded rollback.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, tests and one production publication are authorized. No supplier writeback, real booking, lead or outbound message is authorized.
